rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The second line up is G, where the treble clef curls.
rows.translation: Önnur línan að neðan er G, þar sem G-lykillinn sveigist.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Play or sing the spaces from bottom to top: F, A, C, E.
rows.translation: Spilaðu eða syngdu bilin frá botni að toppi: F, A, C, E.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: When a note goes above or below the staff, short extra lines called ledger lines extend it. Middle C sits on one ledger line just below the treble staff.
rows.translation: Þegar nóta fer upp fyrir eða niður fyrir nótnastrenginn lengja stuttar aukalínur hann; þær kallast hjálparlínur. Mið-C situr á einni hjálparlínu rétt fyrir neðan nótnastrenginn í G-lykli.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: One ledger line below the treble staff is middle C.
rows.translation: Ein hjálparlína fyrir neðan nótnastrenginn í G-lykli er mið-C.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: D hangs in the space just below the bottom line.
rows.translation: D hangir í bilinu rétt fyrir neðan neðstu línuna.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Above the top line, the pattern keeps going. G sits just above the top line, and A sits on the first ledger line above.
rows.translation: Fyrir ofan efstu línuna heldur mynstrið áfram. G situr rétt fyrir ofan efstu línuna og A á fyrstu hjálparlínu fyrir ofan.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: One ledger line above the treble staff is A.
rows.translation: Ein hjálparlína fyrir ofan nótnastrenginn í G-lykli er A.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Count down: middle C on the first ledger line, B below it, A on the second ledger line.
rows.translation: Teldu niður: mið-C á fyrstu hjálparlínu, B fyrir neðan það, A á annarri hjálparlínu.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Play or sing middle C, then D and E, climbing from the ledger line onto the staff.
rows.translation: Spilaðu eða syngdu mið-C, svo D og E, upp frá hjálparlínunni inn á nótnastrenginn.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Low instruments and voices read the bass clef, or F clef. Its two dots surround the fourth line up, marking the F below middle C.
rows.translation: Lág hljóðfæri og raddir lesa F-lykilinn. Punktarnir tveir umlykja fjórðu línu að neðan og merkja F fyrir neðan mið-C.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which note do the bass clef's dots mark?
rows.translation: Hvaða nótu merkja punktarnir í F-lyklinum?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The bass clef is the F clef: its dots frame the F line.
rows.translation: Bassalykillinn er F-lykill: punktarnir hans umlykja F-línuna.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The bass staff's lines, bottom to top, are G, B, D, F, A: Good Boys Do Fine Always. The spaces are A, C, E, G: All Cows Eat Grass.
rows.translation: Línurnar í F-lykli, frá botni að toppi, eru G, B, D, F, A: Góð börn dansa fyrir afa. Bilin eru A, C, E, G: Anna, Clara, Einar, Gunnar.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The bottom line of the bass staff is G, the Good of Good Boys Do Fine Always.
rows.translation: Neðsta línan í F-lykli er G, Góð í Góð börn dansa fyrir afa.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The second space up is C: All Cows.
rows.translation: Annað bilið að neðan er C: Anna, Clara.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The top line of the bass staff is A, the Always of Good Boys Do Fine Always.
rows.translation: Efsta línan í F-lykli er A, afa í Góð börn dansa fyrir afa.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Where is middle C in bass clef?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: On a ledger line above the staff
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Middle C sits one ledger line above the bass staff, and one below the treble staff.
rows.translation: Mið-C situr á einni hjálparlínu fyrir ofan nótnastrenginn í F-lykli og einni fyrir neðan í G-lykli.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Play or sing the bass clef spaces: A, C, E, G.
rows.translation: Spilaðu eða syngdu bilin í F-lykli: A, C, E, G.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Lines, spaces, ledger lines and both clefs. Use your memory sentences, then try to recognize each note at a glance.
rows.translation: Línur, bil, hjálparlínur og báðir lyklar. Notaðu minnissetningarnar og reyndu svo að þekkja hverja nótu við fyrstu sýn.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The third space up in bass clef is E: All Cows Eat.
rows.translation: Þriðja bilið að neðan í F-lykli er E: Anna, Clara, Einar.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Play or sing middle C, then E, G, and the C in the third space.
rows.translation: Spilaðu eða syngdu mið-C, svo E, G og C í þriðja bilinu.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Note values from whole to sixteenth, dots and rests, and the meters 4/4, 3/4 and 6/8.
rows.translation: Nótnagildi frá heilnótu að sextándapartsnótu, punktar og þagnir og taktarnir 4/4, 3/4 og 6/8.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The beat is the steady pulse you tap your foot to. Beats are grouped into bars, also called measures. In most music, each bar holds four beats.
rows.translation: Slagið er stöðugi púlsinn sem þú slærð fætinum í takt við. Slög raðast í takta, einnig kallaða taktbil. Í flestri tónlist eru fjögur slög í hverjum takti.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Count each bar out loud: 1, 2, 3, 4. Beat 1, the downbeat, usually feels strongest. Lean into it a little.
rows.translation: Teldu hvern takt upphátt: 1, 2, 3, 4. Slag 1, fyrsta slagið, er yfirleitt sterkast. Leggðu aðeins meiri áherslu á það.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: What's another word for a bar?
rows.translation: Hvað er annað orð yfir takt?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Bar and measure mean the same thing.
rows.translation: Taktur og taktbil merkja það sama.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Beat 1, the downbeat, starts each bar.
rows.translation: Slag 1, fyrsta slagið, byrjar hvern takt.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A note's shape tells you how long it lasts. In a four-beat bar, a whole note lasts all four beats, a half note two, and a quarter note one.
rows.translation: Lögun nótu segir hversu lengi hún varir. Í fjögurra slaga takti varir heilnóta öll fjögur slögin, hálfnóta tvö og fjórðapartsnóta eitt.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: How many beats does a half note last?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Two half notes fill a four-beat bar.
rows.translation: Tvær hálfnótur fylla fjögurra slaga takt.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: How many quarter notes fill a bar of four beats?
rows.translation: Hve margar fjórðapartsnótur fylla fjögurra slaga takt?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat, so four fill the bar.
rows.translation: Fjórðapartsnóta varir eitt slag svo fjórar fylla taktinn.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A whole note lasts four beats, a half note two, a quarter note one.
rows.translation: Heilnóta varir fjögur slög, hálfnóta tvö og fjórðapartsnóta eitt.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A bar can mix values, as long as they add up. A half note plus two quarter notes fills four beats: 2 + 1 + 1.
rows.translation: Taktur getur blandað nótnagildum svo lengi sem summan passar. Hálfnóta og tvær fjórðapartsnótur fylla fjögur slög: 2 + 1 + 1.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in each beat. Count them 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and, saying and between the beats.
rows.translation: Áttundapartsnóta varir hálft slag svo tvær rúmast í hverju slagi. Teldu 1 og 2 og 3 og 4 og, með og á milli slaganna.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A sixteenth note lasts a quarter of a beat, so four fit in each beat. Count them 1 e and a, 2 e and a.
rows.translation: Sextándapartsnóta varir fjórðung úr slagi svo fjórar rúmast í hverju slagi. Teldu 1 e og a, 2 e og a.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: How many sixteenth notes equal one quarter note?
rows.translation: Hve margar sextándapartsnótur jafngilda einni fjórðapartsnótu?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A quarter note is one beat, and four sixteenths fit in a beat.
rows.translation: Fjórðapartsnóta er eitt slag og fjórar sextándapartsnótur rúmast í slagi.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: How many eighth notes fill a bar of four beats?
rows.translation: Hve margar áttundapartsnótur fylla fjögurra slaga takt?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Two per beat, four beats: eight eighth notes.
rows.translation: Tvær í slagi, fjögur slög: átta áttundapartsnótur.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A dot after a note adds half its value. A half note lasts two beats, so a dotted half lasts three. A dotted quarter lasts one and a half.
rows.translation: Punktur á eftir nótu bætir við helmingi gildis hennar. Hálfnóta varir tvö slög svo punktuð hálfnóta varir þrjú. Punktuð fjórðapartsnóta varir eitt og hálft.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Half of two is one, so the dot adds one beat: 2 + 1 = 3.
rows.translation: Helmingur af tveimur er einn svo punkturinn bætir við einu slagi: 2 + 1 = 3.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A rest is a measured silence. Each note value has a matching rest: a quarter rest lasts one beat, a half rest two. Keep counting through them.
rows.translation: Þögn er mæld hljóðleysa. Hvert nótnagildi á samsvarandi þögn: fjórðapartsþögn varir eitt slag, hálfþögn tvö. Haltu áfram að telja í gegnum þær.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A quarter is one beat; the dot adds half of that.
rows.translation: Fjórðapartsnóta er eitt slag; punkturinn bætir við helmingi þess.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A four-beat bar has a half note and a quarter note. What fills the gap?
rows.translation: Fjögurra slaga taktur hefur hálfnótu og fjórðapartsnótu. Hvað fyllir bilið?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: 2 + 1 = 3, so one beat is left: a quarter rest.
rows.translation: 2 + 1 = 3, svo eitt slag er eftir: fjórðapartsþögn.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The two stacked numbers at the start of a piece are the time signature. The top number counts beats per bar. The bottom shows which note gets one beat: 4 means a quarter note.
rows.translation: Tölurnar tvær, hvor fyrir ofan aðra í upphafi verks, eru taktvísirinn. Efri talan telur slög í takti. Sú neðri sýnir hvaða nóta fær eitt slag: 4 merkir fjórðapartsnótu.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In 4/4, how many quarter-note beats are in a bar?
rows.translation: Í 4/4, hve mörg fjórðapartsnótuslög eru í takti?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The top 4 means four beats; the bottom 4 makes each one a quarter note.
rows.translation: Efri 4 merkir fjögur slög; neðri 4 gerir hvert þeirra að fjórðapartsnótu.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In 3/4, each bar holds three quarter-note beats. Count 1, 2, 3, with the weight on 1. It's the lilt of a waltz.
rows.translation: Í 3/4 hefur hver taktur þrjú fjórðapartsnótuslög. Teldu 1, 2, 3, með áherslu á 1. Þetta er sveifla valsins.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which time signature is a waltz usually in?
rows.translation: Í hvaða taktvísi er vals yfirleitt?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In 6/8, each bar holds six eighth notes in two groups of three. It feels like two big beats, each split in three: 1 2 3, 4 5 6.
rows.translation: Í 6/8 hefur hver taktur sex áttundapartsnótur í tveimur þriggja nótna hópum. Hann finnst eins og tvö stór slög, hvort skipt í þrennt: 1 2 3, 4 5 6.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Two beats, each split in three
rows.translation: Tvö slög, hvort skipt í þrennt
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Three beats, each split in two
rows.translation: Þrjú slög, hvert skipt í tvennt
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The eighths group 1 2 3, 4 5 6, so you feel two strong pulses per bar.
rows.translation: Áttundapartsnóturnar raðast 1 2 3, 4 5 6, svo þú finnur tvo sterka púlsa í takti.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In 3/4, which single note fills a whole bar?
rows.translation: Í 3/4, hvaða staka nóta fyllir heilan takt?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Three beats: a half note (2) plus its dot (1).
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Note values, dots, rests and time signatures together. Count out loud as you tap; your voice keeps your hands honest.
rows.translation: Nótnagildi, punktar, þagnir og taktvísar saman. Teldu upphátt á meðan þú bankar; röddin heldur höndunum á réttri braut.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: How many beats does a whole note last in 4/4?
rows.translation: Hve mörg slög varir heilnóta í 4/4?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: How many sixteenth notes fit in one beat?
rows.translation: Hve margar sextándapartsnótur rúmast í einu slagi?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: What does a dot add to a note?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A bar of 3/4 has a quarter note and a quarter rest. What's missing?
rows.translation: Taktur í 3/4 hefur fjórðapartsnótu og fjórðapartsþögn. Hvað vantar?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: 3/4 holds three beats; 1 + 1 = 2, so one beat remains.
rows.translation: 3/4 hefur þrjú slög; 1 + 1 = 2, svo eitt slag er eftir.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: How many eighth notes are in a bar of 6/8?
rows.translation: Hve margar áttundapartsnótur eru í takti í 6/8?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The whole-and-half-step recipe, four major keys, and their key signatures.
rows.translation: Uppskrift heil- og hálftónsskrefa, fjórar dúrtóntegundir og föst formerki þeirra.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A scale is a set of notes climbing in order from a home note to the same note an octave up. C major uses only white keys: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C.
rows.translation: Tónstigi er röð tóna sem stíga frá heimatóni að sama tóni áttund ofar. C-dúr notar aðeins hvíta lykla: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: How many different letters are in a major scale?
rows.translation: Hve margir ólíkir bókstafir eru í dúrtónstiga?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Seven letters, then the first one returns an octave higher.
rows.translation: Sjö bókstafir og svo kemur sá fyrsti aftur áttund ofar.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Is this scale going up or down?
rows.translation: Fer þessi tónstigi upp eða niður?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In C major, most neighbors are a whole step apart. Only E to F and B to C are half steps. That uneven spacing gives the scale its sound.
rows.translation: Í C-dúr er heiltónsskref á milli flestra nágranna. Aðeins E til F og B til C eru hálftónsskref. Þessi ójöfnu bil gefa tónstiganum hljóm hans.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In C major, which steps are half steps?
rows.translation: Hvaða skref eru hálftónsskref í C-dúr?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: C to D and F to G
rows.translation: C til D og F til G
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: E to F and B to C
rows.translation: E til F og B til C
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: D to E and A to B
rows.translation: D til E og A til B
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: E and F, and B and C, have no black key between them.
rows.translation: Enginn svartur lykill er á milli E og F eða B og C.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: What's the home note of C major?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The home note, called the tonic, gives the scale its name.
rows.translation: Heimatónninn, kallaður grunntónn, gefur tónstiganum nafn sitt.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Play or sing the C major scale, up from middle C.
rows.translation: Spilaðu eða syngdu C-dúrtónstigann upp frá mið-C.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Every major scale follows one recipe of steps: whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half. Start on any note, follow it, and you build a major scale.
rows.translation: Allir dúrtónstigar fylgja einni skrefauppskrift: heilt, heilt, hálft, heilt, heilt, heilt, hálft. Byrjaðu á hvaða tóni sem er og fylgdu henni til að byggja dúrtónstiga.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which is the major scale recipe? (W = whole, H = half)
rows.translation: Hver er uppskrift dúrtónstigans? (W = heilt, H = hálft)
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: W W H W W W H
rows.translation: W W H W W W H
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: W H W W H W W
rows.translation: W H W W H W W
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: W W W H W W H
rows.translation: W W W H W W H
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half.
rows.translation: Heilt, heilt, hálft, heilt, heilt, heilt, hálft.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Number the scale's notes 1 to 8. Where are the half steps?
rows.translation: Númeraðu tóna tónstigans frá 1 til 8. Hvar eru hálftónsskrefin?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Whole, whole, then half from 3 to 4; whole, whole, whole, then half from 7 to 8.
rows.translation: Heilt, heilt og svo hálft frá 3 til 4; heilt, heilt, heilt og svo hálft frá 7 til 8.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Starting on G, a whole step up lands on...
rows.translation: Ef byrjað er á G lendir heiltónsskref upp á…
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: G to A skips one key, G♯.
rows.translation: G til A sleppir einum lykli, G♯.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Play or sing the first four notes of D major: whole, whole, half.
rows.translation: Spilaðu eða syngdu fyrstu fjóra tóna D-dúrs: heilt, heilt, hálft.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Start on G and follow the recipe: G, A, B, C, D, E, then a whole step to F♯ and a half step home to G. G major has one sharp: F♯.
rows.translation: Byrjaðu á G og fylgdu uppskriftinni: G, A, B, C, D, E, svo heiltónsskref að F♯ og hálftónsskref heim að G. G-dúr hefur einn kross: F♯.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Why does G major need F♯ instead of F?
rows.translation: Af hverju þarf G-dúr F♯ í stað F?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: F is too low to sing
rows.translation: F er of lágt til að syngja
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: E to F is only a half step
rows.translation: E til F er aðeins hálftónsskref
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The recipe needs a whole step from note 6 to 7, then a half step from 7 up to G.
rows.translation: Uppskriftin þarf heiltónsskref frá tóni 6 til 7 og svo hálftónsskref frá 7 upp að G.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which note is in G major?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: G major's seventh note is F♯.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: How many sharps are in G major?
rows.translation: Hve margir krossar eru í G-dúr?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Play or sing the G major scale. Remember the F♯.
rows.translation: Spilaðu eða syngdu G-dúrtónstigann. Mundu eftir F♯.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: From D, the recipe gives D, E, F♯, G, A, B, C♯, D. D major has two sharps: F♯ and C♯.
rows.translation: Frá D gefur uppskriftin D, E, F♯, G, A, B, C♯, D. D-dúr hefur tvo krossa: F♯ og C♯.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which two sharps are in D major?
rows.translation: Hvaða tveir krossar eru í D-dúr?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Following the recipe from D lands on F♯ as note 3 and C♯ as note 7.
rows.translation: Ef uppskriftinni er fylgt frá D verður F♯ tónn 3 og C♯ tónn 7.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: From F, the recipe needs a half step from A to the fourth note, so it's B♭, not B. F major: F, G, A, B♭, C, D, E, F. One flat: B♭.
rows.translation: Frá F þarf uppskriftin hálftónsskref frá A að fjórða tóni, svo hann er B♭, ekki B. F-dúr: F, G, A, B♭, C, D, E, F. Eitt bé: B♭.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which note is in F major?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: F major's fourth note is B♭, a half step above A.
rows.translation: Fjórði tónn F-dúrs er B♭, hálftónsskrefi fyrir ofan A.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which major key has two sharps?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: D major has F♯ and C♯.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Play or sing up F major from F to C. The fourth note is B♭.
rows.translation: Spilaðu eða syngdu upp F-dúr frá F að C. Fjórði tónninn er B♭.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Rather than writing F♯ every time, music in G major puts one sharp at the start of each line. That's the key signature: it lists the notes that are always sharp or flat.
rows.translation: Í stað þess að skrifa F♯ í hvert sinn setur tónlist í G-dúr einn kross í upphaf hverrar nótnalínu. Það er fasta formerkið: það sýnir hvaða tónar eru alltaf hækkaðir eða lækkaðir.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A key signature has one sharp, F♯. Which major key is it?
rows.translation: Föstu formerkin sýna einn kross, F♯. Hvaða dúrtóntegund er það?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: G major is the major key with just F♯.
rows.translation: G-dúr er dúrtóntegundin með aðeins F♯.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A key signature has one flat, B♭. Which major key is it?
rows.translation: Föstu formerkin sýna eitt bé, B♭. Hvaða dúrtóntegund er það?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: F major is the major key with just B♭.
rows.translation: F-dúr er dúrtóntegundin með aðeins B♭.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Sharps always appear in the same order: F♯, C♯, G♯, and so on. The last sharp is a half step below the key's name. One sharp, F♯: G major.
rows.translation: Krossar birtast alltaf í sömu röð: F♯, C♯, G♯ og svo framvegis. Síðasti krossinn er hálftónsskrefi fyrir neðan heiti tóntegundarinnar. Einn kross, F♯: G-dúr.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A key signature has two sharps, F♯ and C♯. Which major key is it?
rows.translation: Föstu formerkin sýna tvo krossa, F♯ og C♯. Hvaða dúrtóntegund er það?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The last sharp, C♯, is a half step below D.
rows.translation: Síðasti krossinn, C♯, er hálftónsskrefi fyrir neðan D.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which major key has no sharps or flats?
rows.translation: Hvaða dúrtóntegund hefur hvorki krossa né bé?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: C major uses only white keys.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The key signature shows B♭. Which Bs are played as B♭?
rows.translation: Föstu formerkin sýna B♭. Hvaða B-tónar eru spilaðir sem B♭?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A key signature applies to every B in every octave, unless the music marks otherwise.
rows.translation: Föst formerki gilda um alla B-tóna í öllum áttundum nema annað sé merkt í nótunum.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Play or sing D major, with its two sharps: F♯ and C♯.
rows.translation: Spilaðu eða syngdu D-dúr með krossunum tveimur: F♯ og C♯.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The recipe, four keys and their signatures. When unsure, build the scale from its home note: whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half.
rows.translation: Uppskriftin, fjórar tóntegundir og föst formerki þeirra. Í vafa skaltu byggja tónstigann frá heimatóninum: heilt, heilt, hálft, heilt, heilt, heilt, hálft.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which note belongs in G major?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: G major's only sharp is F♯.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which major key has one flat?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: F major's one flat is B♭.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which scale has the notes D, E, F♯, G, A, B, C♯?
rows.translation: Hvaða tónstigi hefur tónana D, E, F♯, G, A, B, C♯?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In every major scale, which step is a half step?
rows.translation: Hvaða skref er hálftónsskref í öllum dúrtónstigum?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Whole, whole, half: the first half step falls between notes 3 and 4.
rows.translation: Heilt, heilt, hálft: fyrsta hálftónsskrefið er á milli tóna 3 og 4.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which key signature belongs to G major?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Play or sing F major, with its B♭.
rows.translation: Spilaðu eða syngdu F-dúr með B♭.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Name the distance between two notes by number and quality, and measure it in half steps.
rows.translation: Nefndu bilið milli tveggja tóna eftir tölu og gerð og mældu það í hálftónsskrefum.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: An interval's number comes from counting letter names, including both ends. C up to E counts C, D, E: three letters, so it's a third.
rows.translation: Tala tónbils fæst með því að telja bókstafaheitin, með báðum endum. C upp á E telur C, D, E: þrír bókstafir, svo þetta er þríund.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: C up to G is a...
rows.translation: Frá C upp á G er…
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: C, D, E, F, G: five letters.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F, G: fimm bókstafir.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: E, F, G, A: four letters.
rows.translation: E, F, G, A: fjórir bókstafir.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Sharps and flats don't change an interval's number. C to E♭ and C to E are both thirds: C, D, E either way. They differ in size, which comes next.
rows.translation: Krossar og bé breyta ekki tölu tónbils. C til E♭ og C til E eru bæði þríundir: C, D, E í báðum tilvikum. Þau eru ólík að stærð, sem kemur næst.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: F up to D is a...
rows.translation: Frá F upp á D er…
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: F, G, A, B, C, D: six letters.
rows.translation: F, G, A, B, C, D: sex bókstafir.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A up to E♭ is a...
rows.translation: Frá A upp á E♭ er…
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A, B, C, D, E: five letters. The flat doesn't change the count.
rows.translation: A, B, C, D, E: fimm bókstafir. Béið breytir ekki talningunni.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: G up to the next G is a...
rows.translation: Frá G upp að næsta G er…
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: G, A, B, C, D, E, F, G: eight letters, an octave.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C, D, E, F, G: átta bókstafir, áttund.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Two intervals with the same number can differ in size. To measure exactly, count half steps. C up to E is four; C up to E♭ is three.
rows.translation: Tvö tónbil með sömu tölu geta verið misstór. Til að mæla nákvæmlega skaltu telja hálftónsskref. C upp á E er fjögur; C upp á E♭ er þrjú.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: How many half steps from D up to F?
rows.translation: Hve mörg hálftónsskref eru frá D upp á F?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: D, D♯, E, F: three moves.
rows.translation: D, D♯, E, F: þrjár færslur.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A third of four half steps is a major third, like C to E. A third of three is a minor third, like C to E♭ or A to C.
rows.translation: Þríund með fjórum hálftónsskrefum er stór þríund, eins og C til E. Þríund með þremur er lítil þríund, eins og C til E♭ eða A til C.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: E up to G♯ is a...
rows.translation: Frá E upp á G♯ er…
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: E to G♯ spans four half steps.
rows.translation: E til G♯ spannar fjögur hálftónsskref.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A up to C is a...
rows.translation: Frá A upp á C er…
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A to C spans three half steps.
rows.translation: A til C spannar þrjú hálftónsskref.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: G up to B♭ is a...
rows.translation: Frá G upp á B♭ er…
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: G to B♭ spans three half steps.
rows.translation: G til B♭ spannar þrjú hálftónsskref.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Unisons, fourths, fifths and octaves are called perfect. A perfect fourth spans five half steps, a perfect fifth seven, and an octave twelve.
rows.translation: Prím, ferund, fimmund og áttund kallast hrein tónbil. Hrein ferund spannar fimm hálftónsskref, hrein fimmund sjö og áttund tólf.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: How many half steps are in a perfect fifth?
rows.translation: Hve mörg hálftónsskref eru í hreinni fimmund?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: C up to G: seven half steps.
rows.translation: C upp á G: sjö hálftónsskref.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: C up to F is a...
rows.translation: Frá C upp á F er…
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: C to F spans five half steps.
rows.translation: C til F spannar fimm hálftónsskref.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Watch out for B and F
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Most white-key fifths are perfect, but B up to F spans only six half steps. It's called a diminished fifth. When in doubt, count half steps.
rows.translation: Flestar fimmundir á hvítum lyklum eru hreinar en B upp á F spannar aðeins sex hálftónsskref. Það kallast minnkuð fimmund. Í vafa skaltu telja hálftónsskref.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which of these fifths is smaller than perfect?
rows.translation: Hver þessara fimmunda er minni en hrein fimmund?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: B to F spans six half steps; a perfect fifth needs seven.
rows.translation: B til F spannar sex hálftónsskref; hrein fimmund þarf sjö.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A up to D is a...
rows.translation: Frá A upp á D er…
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A, B, C, D: four letters, five half steps.
rows.translation: A, B, C, D: fjórir bókstafir, fimm hálftónsskref.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Seconds, thirds, sixths and sevenths come in major and minor sizes. Minor is always one half step smaller than major.
rows.translation: Tvíundir, þríundir, sexundir og sjöundir eru til bæði stórar og litlar. Lítil eru alltaf einu hálftónsskrefi minni en stór.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Minor second 1, major second 2. Minor third 3, major third 4. Minor sixth 8, major sixth 9. Minor seventh 10, major seventh 11.
rows.translation: Lítil tvíund 1, stór tvíund 2. Lítil þríund 3, stór þríund 4. Lítil sexund 8, stór sexund 9. Lítil sjöund 10, stór sjöund 11.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: C up to A is a...
rows.translation: Frá C upp á A er…
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: C to A spans nine half steps.
rows.translation: C til A spannar níu hálftónsskref.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: C up to B♭ is a...
rows.translation: Frá C upp á B♭ er…
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: C to B♭ spans ten half steps.
rows.translation: C til B♭ spannar tíu hálftónsskref.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: E to F is a single half step.
rows.translation: E til F er eitt hálftónsskref.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: How many half steps are in a major seventh?
rows.translation: Hve mörg hálftónsskref eru í stórri sjöund?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: One half step short of an octave.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: E up to C is a...
rows.translation: Frá E upp á C er…
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: E, F, G, A, B, C makes a sixth. It spans eight half steps, so it's minor.
rows.translation: E, F, G, A, B, C myndar sexund. Hún spannar átta hálftónsskref svo hún er lítil.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Count letters for the number. Count half steps for the size. Together they name any interval.
rows.translation: Teldu bókstafi fyrir töluna. Teldu hálftónsskref fyrir stærðina. Saman nefna þau hvaða tónbil sem er.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: F up to A is a...
rows.translation: Frá F upp á A er…
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: F, G, A is a third, and four half steps makes it major.
rows.translation: F, G, A er þríund og fjögur hálftónsskref gera hana stóra.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: D up to A is a...
rows.translation: Frá D upp á A er…
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: D to A spans seven half steps.
rows.translation: D til A spannar sjö hálftónsskref.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: B up to D is a...
rows.translation: Frá B upp á D er…
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: B, C, D is a third of three half steps: minor.
rows.translation: B, C, D er þríund með þremur hálftónsskrefum: lítil.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: How many half steps are in a major sixth?
rows.translation: Hve mörg hálftónsskref eru í stórri sexund?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: G up to F is a...
rows.translation: Frá G upp á F er…
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: G to F covers seven letters and ten half steps: a minor seventh.
rows.translation: G til F nær yfir sjö bókstafi og tíu hálftónsskref: lítil sjöund.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Stack thirds into triads, build major and minor chords, and number the chords of a key.
rows.translation: Staflaðu þríundum í þríhljóma, byggðu dúr- og mollhljóma og númeraðu hljóma tóntegundar.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A triad is three notes stacked in thirds. Start on any note, skip a letter, take the next, skip again. C, skip D, E, skip F, G: C E G.
rows.translation: Þríhljómur er þrír tónar staflaðir í þríundum. Byrjaðu á hvaða tóni sem er, slepptu bókstaf, taktu þann næsta og slepptu aftur. C, slepptu D, E, slepptu F, G: C E G.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which notes make a triad built on G?
rows.translation: Hvaða tónar mynda þríhljóm byggðan á G?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: G, skip A, B, skip C, D.
rows.translation: G, slepptu A, B, slepptu C, D.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The note a triad is built on is its root. The middle note is the third and the top note is the fifth, named for their distance above the root.
rows.translation: Tónninn sem þríhljómur er byggður á er grunntónn hans. Miðtónninn er þríundin og efsti tónninn fimmundin, nefnd eftir bili þeirra fyrir ofan grunntóninn.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In the triad F A C, which note is the root?
rows.translation: Hvaða tónn er grunntónninn í þríhljómnum F A C?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: F is the bottom note the triad is built on.
rows.translation: F er neðsti tónninn sem þríhljómurinn er byggður á.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In the triad D F A, which note is the fifth?
rows.translation: Hvaða tónn er fimmundin í þríhljómnum D F A?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: D up to A is a fifth: D, E, F, G, A.
rows.translation: D upp á A er fimmund: D, E, F, G, A.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Using only white keys, which triad is built on E?
rows.translation: Hvaða þríhljómur er byggður á E með aðeins hvítum lyklum?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: E, skip F, G, skip A, B.
rows.translation: E, slepptu F, G, slepptu A, B.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Play or sing the C triad one note at a time: C, E, G.
rows.translation: Spilaðu eða syngdu C-þríhljóminn, einn tón í einu: C, E, G.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A major triad has a major third on the bottom, four half steps, then a minor third on top. C E G is major. So are F A C and G B D.
rows.translation: Dúrþríhljómur hefur stóra þríund neðst, fjögur hálftónsskref, og svo litla þríund ofan á. C E G er dúr. Það eru F A C og G B D líka.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Flip the thirds and you get minor: a minor third on the bottom, then a major third. Lower the middle note of C major and you get C minor: C E♭ G.
rows.translation: Snúðu þríundunum við og þú færð moll: litla þríund neðst og svo stóra þríund. Lækkaðu miðtón C-dúrs og þú færð C-moll: C E♭ G.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: D to F is a minor third; F to A is a major third.
rows.translation: D til F er lítil þríund; F til A er stór þríund.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: E to G♯ is a major third; G♯ to B is a minor third.
rows.translation: E til G♯ er stór þríund; G♯ til B er lítil þríund.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Is A C E major or minor?
rows.translation: Er A C E dúr eða moll?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A to C is a minor third, three half steps.
rows.translation: A til C er lítil þríund, þrjú hálftónsskref.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Play or sing A minor one note at a time: A, C, E.
rows.translation: Spilaðu eða syngdu A-moll, einn tón í einu: A, C, E.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Build a triad on each note of a scale, using only that scale's notes, and you get the key's family of chords. C major has seven, one per note.
rows.translation: Byggðu þríhljóm á hverjum tóni tónstiga með aðeins tónum þess tónstiga og þá færðu hljómafjölskyldu tóntegundarinnar. C-dúr hefur sjö, einn á hvern tón.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Using only C major notes, what triad is built on D?
rows.translation: Hvaða þríhljómur er byggður á D með aðeins tónum C-dúrs?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: D F A: a minor third, then a major third.
rows.translation: D F A: lítil þríund og svo stór þríund.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Using only C major notes, what triad is built on G?
rows.translation: Hvaða þríhljómur er byggður á G með aðeins tónum C-dúrs?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: G B D: a major third, then a minor third.
rows.translation: G B D: stór þríund og svo lítil þríund.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The triad on B is different: B D F. Both thirds are minor, so it's a diminished triad. It sounds tense and wants to move.
rows.translation: Þríhljómurinn á B er öðruvísi: B D F. Báðar þríundirnar eru litlar svo þetta er minnkaður þríhljómur. Hann hljómar spenntur og vill hreyfast.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In C major, which chords are major?
rows.translation: Hvaða hljómar eru dúrhljómar í C-dúr?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: C E G, F A C and G B D each have a major third on the bottom.
rows.translation: C E G, F A C og G B D hafa hver um sig stóra þríund neðst.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Using only C major notes, what triad is built on A?
rows.translation: Hvaða þríhljómur er byggður á A með aðeins tónum C-dúrs?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A C E: a minor third, then a major third.
rows.translation: A C E: lítil þríund og svo stór þríund.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Play or sing the diminished triad on B: B, D, F.
rows.translation: Spilaðu eða syngdu minnkaða þríhljóminn á B: B, D, F.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Musicians number a key's chords with Roman numerals: I for the chord on note 1, up to vii for note 7. Uppercase means major, lowercase minor, and ° diminished.
rows.translation: Tónlistarfólk númerar hljóma tóntegundar með rómverskum tölum: I fyrir hljóminn á tóni 1, upp að vii fyrir tón 7. Hástafir merkja dúr, lágstafir moll og ° minnkaðan hljóm.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Every major key follows one pattern: I, ii, iii, IV, V, vi, vii°. In C major that's C, D minor, E minor, F, G, A minor and B diminished.
rows.translation: Allar dúrtóntegundir fylgja einu mynstri: I, ii, iii, IV, V, vi, vii°. Í C-dúr er það C, D-moll, E-moll, F, G, A-moll og minnkaður B-hljómur.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In C major, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Hvaða hljómur er IV í C-dúr?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The fourth note of C major is F.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In C major, which chord is vi?
rows.translation: Hvaða hljómur er vi í C-dúr?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The sixth note is A, and lowercase vi means minor.
rows.translation: Sjötti tónninn er A og vi með lágstöfum merkir moll.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In G major, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Hvaða hljómur er V í G-dúr?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Count up from G: G, A, B, C, D. The fifth note is D, and V is major.
rows.translation: Teldu upp frá G: G, A, B, C, D. Fimmti tónninn er D og V er dúr.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Why is ii written in lowercase?
rows.translation: Af hverju er ii skrifað með lágstöfum?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In G major, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Hvaða hljómur er IV í G-dúr?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: G, A, B, C: the fourth note is C.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C: fjórði tónninn er C.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Spell it, hear it, number it
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Stack thirds, check their sizes, then place the chord in its key: major on I, IV and V, minor on ii, iii and vi, diminished on vii°.
rows.translation: Staflaðu þríundum, athugaðu stærðirnar og staðsettu svo hljóminn í tóntegundinni: dúr á I, IV og V, moll á ii, iii og vi, minnkaður á vii°.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In C major, which chord is ii?
rows.translation: Hvaða hljómur er ii í C-dúr?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In F major, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Hvaða hljómur er V í F-dúr?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: F, G, A, B♭, C: the fifth note is C.
rows.translation: F, G, A, B♭, C: fimmti tónninn er C.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: B to D and D to F are both minor thirds.
rows.translation: B til D og D til F eru bæði litlar þríundir.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Play or sing the G major triad: G, B, D.
rows.translation: Spilaðu eða syngdu G-dúrþríhljóminn: G, B, D.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: How chords move in songs: I–IV–V, the pop loop, ii–V–I, the 12-bar blues and cadences.
rows.translation: Hvernig hljómar hreyfast í lögum: I–IV–V, popplykkjan, ii–V–I, 12 takta blús og niðurlög.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Countless folk, rock and country songs use just three chords: I, IV and V. In C major, that's C, F and G. Together they hold every note of the scale.
rows.translation: Ótal þjóðlög, rokk- og kántrílög nota aðeins þrjá hljóma: I, IV og V. Í C-dúr eru það C, F og G. Saman innihalda þeir alla tóna tónstigans.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In G major, what are I, IV and V?
rows.translation: Hvað eru I, IV og V í G-dúr?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Count up from G: note 1 is G, note 4 is C, note 5 is D.
rows.translation: Teldu upp frá G: tónn 1 er G, tónn 4 er C, tónn 5 er D.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Does this end on the home chord?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.translation: Heima, að heiman og til baka
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: I feels like home. IV moves away. V builds tension that pulls back to I. That trip, out and back again, shapes a huge number of songs.
rows.translation: I er eins og heima. IV fer að heiman. V byggir spennu sem dregur aftur að I. Þessi ferð, út og aftur heim, mótar gríðarlegan fjölda laga.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which chord pulls most strongly back to I?
rows.translation: Hvaða hljómur leitar sterkast aftur að I?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: V builds tension that resolves to I.
rows.translation: V byggir spennu sem leysist á I.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In D major, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Hvaða hljómur er IV í D-dúr?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: D, E, F♯, G: the fourth note is G.
rows.translation: D, E, F♯, G: fjórði tónninn er G.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of I, IV, V, I in C: C, F, G, C.
rows.translation: Spilaðu eða syngdu grunntóna I, IV, V, I í C: C, F, G, C.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: This four-chord loop runs under a huge number of pop songs. In C major it's C, G, A minor, F. The minor vi adds a touch of shade before IV lifts back toward home.
rows.translation: Þessi fjögurra hljóma lykkja liggur undir gríðarlegum fjölda popplaga. Í C-dúr er hún C, G, A-moll, F. Mollhljómurinn vi bætir við smáskugga áður en IV lyftir aftur í átt að heimahljómnum.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In G major, what is I–V–vi–IV?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In G: I is G, V is D, vi is E minor, IV is C.
rows.translation: Í G: I er G, V er D, vi er E-moll, IV er C.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Start the same loop on vi and you get vi–IV–I–V: A minor, F, C, G. The chords are identical, but beginning on minor makes it sound more serious.
rows.translation: Byrjaðu sömu lykkju á vi og þú færð vi–IV–I–V: A-moll, F, C, G. Hljómarnir eru þeir sömu en upphaf á moll lætur hana hljóma alvarlegri.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In F major, which chord is vi?
rows.translation: Hvaða hljómur er vi í F-dúr?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: F, G, A, B♭, C, D: the sixth note is D, and vi is minor.
rows.translation: F, G, A, B♭, C, D: sjötti tónninn er D og vi er moll.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of I–V–vi–IV in C: C, G, A, F.
rows.translation: Spilaðu eða syngdu grunntóna I–V–vi–IV í C: C, G, A, F.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: ii–V–I is the most common progression in jazz. In C major: D minor, G, C. Each root falls a fifth to the next, so the move feels like coming home.
rows.translation: ii–V–I er algengasti hljómagangurinn í djassi. Í C-dúr: D-moll, G, C. Hver grunntónn fer niður um fimmund að þeim næsta svo hreyfingin er eins og að koma heim.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In C major, what is ii–V–I?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: ii is D minor, V is G, and I is C.
rows.translation: ii er D-moll, V er G og I er C.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Jazz players usually add sevenths: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7. The extra notes make each move even smoother. The roots and the trip home stay the same.
rows.translation: Djasstónlistarfólk bætir yfirleitt við sjöundum: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7. Aukatónarnir gera hverja hreyfingu enn mýkri. Grunntónarnir og heimferðin haldast óbreytt.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In F major, what is ii–V–I?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: F, G, A, B♭, C: ii is G minor and V is C.
rows.translation: F, G, A, B♭, C: ii er G-moll og V er C.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In ii–V–I, how do the roots move?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.translation: Upp um skref í hvert sinn
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.translation: Niður um skref í hvert sinn
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.translation: Niður um fimmund í hvert sinn
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: D down to G, then G down to C: a fifth each time.
rows.translation: D niður á G og svo G niður á C: fimmund í hvert sinn.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of ii–V–I in C: D, down to G, up to C.
rows.translation: Spilaðu eða syngdu grunntóna ii–V–I í C: D, niður á G, upp á C.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The 12-bar blues is a chord plan, twelve bars long, behind countless blues, rock and jazz tunes. It uses I, IV and V, often all as dominant seventh chords for a bluesy edge.
rows.translation: 12 takta blúsinn er tólf takta hljómaskipan á bak við ótal blús-, rokk- og djasslög. Hann notar I, IV og V, oft alla sem forhljómssjöundarhljóma fyrir blúslegan blæ.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Four bars of I. Two of IV, two of I. One of V, one of IV, two of I. Then it repeats. In A: A7 four times, D7 twice, A7 twice, E7, D7, A7 twice.
rows.translation: Fjórir taktar af I. Tveir af IV, tveir af I. Einn af V, einn af IV, tveir af I. Svo er endurtekið. Í A: A7 fjórum sinnum, D7 tvisvar, A7 tvisvar, E7, D7, A7 tvisvar.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: How many bars of I open the 12-bar blues?
rows.translation: Hve margir taktar af I byrja 12 takta blúsinn?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Four bars of I, then IV arrives in bar 5.
rows.translation: Fjórir taktar af I og svo kemur IV í takti 5.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In the 12-bar blues, which chord is in bar 9?
rows.translation: Hvaða hljómur er í takti 9 í 12 takta blúsnum?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Bar 9 is the one bar of V, before IV in bar 10.
rows.translation: Taktur 9 er eini takturinn af V, á undan IV í takti 10.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In the key of E, what are the three blues chords?
rows.translation: Hverjir eru blúshljómarnir þrír í tóntegundinni E?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In E, I is E, IV is A and V is B.
rows.translation: Í E er I E, IV er A og V er B.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of the blues in A: A, D, E, back to A.
rows.translation: Spilaðu eða syngdu grunntóna blússins í A: A, D, E, aftur að A.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A cadence is the chord move that ends a phrase, like punctuation. V to I is the strongest, a full stop. It's called an authentic cadence.
rows.translation: Niðurlag er hljómahreyfingin sem endar hendingu, eins og greinarmerki. V til I er sterkust, eins og punktur. Það kallast autentískt niðurlag.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.translation: Hljómar þessi hending eins og henni sé lokið?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: IV to I is a plagal cadence, the soft amen at the end of many hymns. Stopping on V is a half cadence, like a comma. V to vi is deceptive: you expect home and get a surprise.
rows.translation: IV til I er plagalt niðurlag, hið mjúka amen í lok margra sálma. Að stoppa á V er hálfniðurlag, eins og komma. V til vi er blekkingarniðurlag: þú býst við heimahljómnum en færð óvæntan snúning.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which cadence ends a phrase on V?
rows.translation: Hvaða niðurlag endar hendingu á V?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A half cadence pauses on V, like a comma.
rows.translation: Hálfniðurlag nemur staðar á V, eins og komma.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which cadence is called the amen cadence?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: IV to I is the soft amen at the end of many hymns.
rows.translation: IV til I er hið mjúka amen í lok margra sálma.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Home, away and back again. Name the progression, then the cadence that ends it. Listen for where the music wants to rest.
rows.translation: Heima, að heiman og aftur heim. Nefndu hljómaganginn og svo niðurlagið sem endar hann. Hlustaðu eftir því hvar tónlistin vill hvílast.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In D major, what is I–V–vi–IV?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In D: I is D, V is A, vi is B minor, IV is G.
rows.translation: Í D: I er D, V er A, vi er B-moll, IV er G.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In which bar does the 12-bar blues first move to IV?
rows.translation: Í hvaða takti fer 12 takta blúsinn fyrst á IV?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.translation: Hvaða niðurlag hljómar mest eins og endir?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: V to I is the full stop of music.
rows.translation: V til I er punktur tónlistarinnar.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of I–IV–V–I in G: G, C, D, G.
rows.translation: Spilaðu eða syngdu grunntóna I–IV–V–I í G: G, C, D, G.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Feel the beat, count it, and tap it in time
rows.translation: Finndu slagið, teldu það og bankaðu í takt
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Find the pulse, count to four, and tap in time.
rows.translation: Finndu púlsinn, teldu upp að fjórum og bankaðu í takt.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The beat is a steady pulse
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The beat is the steady pulse you tap your foot to. It never rushes or drags, like footsteps on an easy walk. Every rhythm sits on top of it.
rows.translation: Slagið er stöðugi púlsinn sem þú slærð fætinum í takt við. Það flýtir sér hvorki né hægir á sér, eins og fótatak í rólegri göngu. Öll hrynjandi byggist á því.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Hold your fingertip just above the screen and tap each time the click sounds. Let it bounce off the glass like a drumstick. Aim to land with the click, not after it.
rows.translation: Haltu fingurgómnum rétt fyrir ofan skjáinn og bankaðu í hvert sinn sem smellurinn hljómar. Láttu hann skoppa af glerinu eins og trommukjuða. Miðaðu við að lenda með smellinum, ekki á eftir honum.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A beat keeps the same space between pulses, like a clock ticking.
rows.translation: Slag heldur sama bili milli púlsa, eins og tifandi klukka.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: How many clicks did you hear?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Most music groups beats in fours. Count 1, 2, 3, 4 out loud with the click, then start again at 1. Saying the numbers helps your hands keep time.
rows.translation: Flest tónlist raðar slögum í ferndir. Teldu 1, 2, 3, 4 upphátt með smellinum og byrjaðu svo aftur á 1. Að segja tölurnar hjálpar höndunum að halda takti.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A bar is one group of beats. Here each bar holds four beats, written 4/4. Beat 1 starts every bar, so lean on it a little as you count.
rows.translation: Taktur er einn hópur slaga. Hér hefur hver taktur fjögur slög, skrifað 4/4. Slag 1 byrjar hvern takt svo leggðu aðeins meiri áherslu á það þegar þú telur.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The strong click is beat 1. How many beats are in each bar?
rows.translation: Sterki smellurinn er slag 1. Hve mörg slög eru í hverjum takti?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Counting starts again at 1 at the top of every bar.
rows.translation: Talningin byrjar aftur á 1 í upphafi hvers takts.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A note that lasts one beat is a quarter note. Four of them fill a bar of 4/4, so tapping on every beat means tapping quarter notes.
rows.translation: Nóta sem varir eitt slag er fjórðapartsnóta. Fjórar slíkar fylla takt í 4/4 svo að banka á hverju slagi merkir að banka fjórðapartsnótur.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Now tap only on 1 and 3. Each tap is a half note, two beats long. Keep counting all four; the beats you skip still happen.
rows.translation: Bankaðu nú aðeins á 1 og 3. Hvert bank er hálfnóta, tvö slög að lengd. Haltu áfram að telja öll fjögur; slögin sem þú sleppir gerast samt.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: You tap on 1 and 3. What happens on 2 and 4?
rows.translation: Þú bankar á 1 og 3. Hvað gerist á 2 og 4?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The beat never stops. You count through the beats you don't tap.
rows.translation: Slagið stoppar aldrei. Þú telur í gegnum slögin sem þú bankar ekki.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A whole note lasts all four beats. Tap once on 1 and count 2, 3, 4 under your breath so the next 1 lands on time.
rows.translation: Heilnóta varir öll fjögur slögin. Bankaðu einu sinni á 1 og teldu 2, 3, 4 lágt svo næsta 1 lendi á réttum tíma.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Tempo is the speed of the beat
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Tempo is how fast the beat goes, counted in beats per minute, or bpm. At 60 bpm the beat comes once a second, like a clock.
rows.translation: Tempó er hversu hratt slögin ganga, talið í slögum á mínútu, eða bpm. Við 60 bpm kemur slag einu sinni á sekúndu, eins og klukka.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: At 60 bpm, how often does the beat come?
rows.translation: Hve oft kemur slagið við 60 bpm?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.translation: Einu sinni á tveggja sekúndna fresti
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: 60 beats in 60 seconds is one beat each second.
rows.translation: 60 slög á 60 sekúndum eru eitt slag á sekúndu.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Faster tempos need less effort, not more. Keep your hand loose and tap from the knuckle, not the wrist or shoulder.
rows.translation: Meiri hraði þarf minni áreynslu, ekki meiri. Haltu hendinni afslappaðri og bankaðu frá hnúanum, ekki úlnliðnum eða öxlinni.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The tempo goes up. What should your taps do?
rows.translation: Hraðinn eykst. Hvernig ættu bankhreyfingarnar að breytast?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Wait a little behind the click
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.translation: Halda áfram að vera litlar og léttar
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Small, relaxed motions are quicker and easier to keep even.
rows.translation: Litlar, afslappaðar hreyfingar eru fljótari og auðveldara er að halda þeim jöfnum.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: This challenge mixes beats, bars, longer notes and tempo. Count out loud the whole way, and keep your taps small and relaxed.
rows.translation: Þessi áskorun blandar slögum, töktum, lengri nótum og hraða. Teldu upphátt alla leið og hafðu bankhreyfingarnar litlar og afslappaðar.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which note lasts a whole bar of 4/4?
rows.translation: Hvaða nóta varir heilan takt í 4/4?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A whole note lasts four beats, the full bar of 4/4.
rows.translation: Heilnóta varir fjögur slög, heilan takt í 4/4.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: bpm counts beats per minute, so 90 bpm is one and a half beats each second.
rows.translation: bpm telur slög á mínútu svo 90 bpm er eitt og hálft slag á hverri sekúndu.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Split each beat in two and count "and."
rows.translation: Skiptu hverju slagi í tvennt og teldu „og“.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in every beat. Eight of them fill a bar of 4/4.
rows.translation: Áttundapartsnóta varir hálft slag svo tvær rúmast í hverju slagi. Átta slíkar fylla takt í 4/4.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Say the number on each beat and "and" exactly halfway between: 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Tap on every word.
rows.translation: Segðu töluna á hverju slagi og „og“ nákvæmlega mitt á milli: 1 og 2 og 3 og 4 og. Bankaðu á hverju orði.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: An eighth note is half a beat, so two fill each beat.
rows.translation: Áttundapartsnóta er hálft slag svo tvær fylla hvert slag.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The strong clicks are the beats. How many beats did you hear?
rows.translation: Sterku smellirnir eru slögin. Hve mörg slög heyrðirðu?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Now some beats get one tap and some get two. Keep saying every "and," even the ones you don't tap.
rows.translation: Nú fá sum slög eitt bank og önnur tvö. Haltu áfram að segja hvert „og“, líka þau sem þú bankar ekki.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: How do you count this pattern?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Beat 1 has two taps, 1 and. Beats 2, 3 and 4 get one tap each.
rows.translation: Slag 1 hefur tvö bank, 1 og. Slög 2, 3 og 4 fá eitt bank hvert.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In eighths, each tap lands on a number or an "and." Before you tap a new pattern, say its counts once out loud.
rows.translation: Í áttundapartsnótum lendir hvert bank á tölu eða „og“. Áður en þú bankar nýtt mynstur skaltu segja talninguna einu sinni upphátt.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.translation: Hvaða talning passar við þetta mynstur?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Beats 1 and 3 have two taps each; beats 2 and 4 have one.
rows.translation: Slög 1 og 3 hafa tvö bank hvort; slög 2 og 4 hafa eitt.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Beat 1 has one tap, beats 2 and 3 have two, and beat 4 has one.
rows.translation: Slag 1 hefur eitt bank, slög 2 og 3 hafa tvö og slag 4 hefur eitt.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The "and" should land exactly halfway between beats. If your eighths sound like a gallop, slow down and say the counts as you tap.
rows.translation: „Og“ á að lenda nákvæmlega mitt á milli slaga. Ef áttundapartsnóturnar hljóma eins og stökk hests skaltu hægja á og segja talninguna á meðan þú bankar.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Your eighths sound uneven. What helps most?
rows.translation: Áttundapartsnóturnar þínar eru ójafnar. Hvað hjálpar mest?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Slow down and count out loud
rows.translation: Að hægja á og telja upphátt
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.translation: Að banka fastar á hverju slagi
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Speed up until it smooths out
rows.translation: Að auka hraðann þar til þær jafnast
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Slowing down gives you time to place each "and" in the middle. Counting keeps it there.
rows.translation: Að hægja á gefur þér tíma til að staðsetja hvert „og“ í miðjunni. Talningin heldur því þar.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Hover just above the glass between taps. A short, light motion is easier to keep even at faster tempos.
rows.translation: Haltu honum rétt fyrir ofan glerið milli banka. Stuttri, léttri hreyfingu er auðveldara að halda jafnri þegar hraðinn eykst.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: This challenge mixes quarters and eighths. Say each pattern's counts once, then tap it with every "and" right in the middle.
rows.translation: Þessi áskorun blandar fjórðaparts- og áttundapartsnótum. Segðu talningu hvers mynsturs einu sinni og bankaðu það svo með hvert „og“ beint í miðjunni.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Leave space on purpose, then tap between the beats.
rows.translation: Skildu eftir rými viljandi og bankaðu svo á milli slaganna.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A rest is a silence with a set length. You still count it; you just don't tap. A quarter rest lasts one beat.
rows.translation: Þögn er hljóðleysa af ákveðinni lengd. Þú telur hana samt; þú bankar bara ekki. Fjórðapartsþögn varir eitt slag.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: What do you do on a rest?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A rest takes up time just like a note. Counting it keeps your place.
rows.translation: Þögn tekur tíma rétt eins og nóta. Að telja hana heldur þér á réttum stað.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Leaving beat 1 empty is the hardest rest. Nod your head on 1 so you feel it without tapping, then come in on 2.
rows.translation: Erfiðasta þögnin er að skilja slag 1 eftir autt. Kinkaðu kolli á 1 svo þú finnir það án þess að banka og komdu svo inn á 2.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.translation: Þögn og svo bank á og
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: An eighth rest lasts half a beat. Count 1 and 2 and, rest on 2, and tap its "and" instead. It feels like a small push into beat 3.
rows.translation: Áttundapartsþögn varir hálft slag. Teldu 1 og 2 og, hafðu þögn á 2 og bankaðu á „og“ þess í staðinn. Það er eins og lítil ýta inn í slag 3.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: It sits halfway between beats 2 and 3, on the "and" of 2.
rows.translation: Það er mitt á milli slaga 2 og 3, á „og“ á eftir 2.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Syncopation puts a strong note between the beats, where your ear doesn't expect one. It makes a rhythm lean forward.
rows.translation: Áherslufærsla setur sterka nótu á milli slaga þar sem eyrað býst ekki við henni. Hún lætur hrynjandina leita fram á við.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: This pattern lands on 1, the "and" of 2, and 4. Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and, and tap only those three spots.
rows.translation: Þetta mynstur lendir á 1, „og“ á eftir 2 og 4. Teldu 1 og 2 og 3 og 4 og og bankaðu aðeins á þessum þremur stöðum.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Count the clicks from 1 to 8. Where do the strong ones fall?
rows.translation: Teldu smellina frá 1 til 8. Hvar lenda þeir sterku?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Syncopation shifts the weight off the beat, onto an "and" or a weak beat.
rows.translation: Áherslufærsla færir þungann af slaginu yfir á „og“ eða veikt slag.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Offbeats are the "and" between beats. Nod on the numbers and tap only the ands, like the chop of a reggae guitar.
rows.translation: Millislög eru „og“ á milli slaga. Kinkaðu kolli á tölunum og bankaðu aðeins á og, eins og stuttur sláttur reggígítars.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The first click is beat 1. Are the strong clicks on the numbers or the ands?
rows.translation: Fyrsti smellurinn er slag 1. Eru sterku smellirnir á tölunum eða á og?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Offbeats fall halfway between the beats, on every "and."
rows.translation: Millislög lenda mitt á milli slaganna, á hverju „og“.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: This challenge mixes rests, the "and" on its own, syncopation and offbeats. Count every eighth out loud, even when you don't tap.
rows.translation: Þessi áskorun blandar þögnum, stökum „og“, áherslufærslu og millislögum. Teldu hverja áttundapartsnótu upphátt, líka þegar þú bankar ekki.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.translation: Hvað af þessu er með áherslufærslu?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Tapping the "and" of 2 and skipping 3 moves the weight off the beat.
rows.translation: Að banka á „og“ á eftir 2 og sleppa 3 færir þungann af slaginu.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Hold notes across the beat with ties and dotted rhythms.
rows.translation: Haltu nótum yfir slög með bindibogum og punktaðri hrynjandi.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A tie is a curved line joining two notes. You play the first and hold it through the second, so the tied note gets no new tap.
rows.translation: Bindibogi er bogin lína sem tengir tvær nótur. Þú spilar þá fyrri og heldur henni út þá seinni svo bundna nótan fær ekkert nýtt bank.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Beat 2 is tied to beat 3. What do you do on 3?
rows.translation: Slag 2 er bundið við slag 3. Hvað gerirðu á 3?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.translation: Heldur áfram að halda, ekkert nýtt bank
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A tie stretches one note. You count 3, but the note from beat 2 keeps sounding.
rows.translation: Bindibogi lengir eina nótu. Þú telur 3 en nótan frá slagi 2 heldur áfram að hljóma.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Tie the "and" of 2 into beat 3. Tap on the "and," then let beat 3 pass while the note rings. It's syncopation, written another way.
rows.translation: Bindu „og“ á eftir 2 við slag 3. Bankaðu á „og“ og láttu svo slag 3 líða á meðan nótan hljómar. Þetta er áherslufærsla skrifuð á annan hátt.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A dot after a note adds half its length. A half note lasts two beats, so a dotted half lasts three. Tap 1, count 2 and 3, tap 4.
rows.translation: Punktur á eftir nótu bætir við helmingi lengdar hennar. Hálfnóta varir tvö slög svo punktuð hálfnóta varir þrjú. Bankaðu á 1, teldu 2 og 3, bankaðu á 4.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. How long is a dotted quarter?
rows.translation: Fjórðapartsnóta varir eitt slag. Hve löng er punktuð fjórðapartsnóta?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Half of one beat is a half beat. Add it and you get one and a half.
rows.translation: Helmingur eins slags er hálft slag. Bættu því við og þú færð eitt og hálft.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A dotted quarter lasts one and a half beats, so the next note lands on an "and." Count 1 and 2 and: tap 1, then the "and" of 2.
rows.translation: Punktuð fjórðapartsnóta varir eitt og hálft slag svo næsta nóta lendir á „og“. Teldu 1 og 2 og: bankaðu á 1 og svo „og“ á eftir 2.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: You tapped this pattern with a rest in Unit 3. What changes with a dot?
rows.translation: Þú bankaðir þetta mynstur með þögn í einingu 3. Hvað breytist með punkti?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The taps land in the same places. Only the length of the first note changes.
rows.translation: Bönkin lenda á sömu stöðum. Aðeins lengd fyrstu nótunnar breytist.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A dotted quarter plus an eighth fills two beats: long, short. Count 1 and 2 and; tap 1 and the "and" of 2.
rows.translation: Punktuð fjórðapartsnóta og áttundapartsnóta fylla tvö slög: langt, stutt. Teldu 1 og 2 og; bankaðu á 1 og „og“ á eftir 2.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A dotted quarter and an eighth together last how long?
rows.translation: Hve lengi vara punktuð fjórðapartsnóta og áttundapartsnóta saman?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: One and a half plus a half is two.
rows.translation: Eitt og hálft ásamt hálfu eru tvö.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which lasts as long as a dotted quarter?
rows.translation: Hvað varir jafn lengi og punktuð fjórðapartsnóta?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A quarter tied to an eighth
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The tie adds half a beat to the quarter, just like the dot does.
rows.translation: Bindiboginn bætir hálfu slagi við fjórðapartsnótuna, rétt eins og punkturinn.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: This challenge mixes ties and dots. Count every eighth out loud; a held note still takes up its full time.
rows.translation: Þessi áskorun blandar bindibogum og punktum. Teldu hverja áttundapartsnótu upphátt; haldin nóta tekur samt allan sinn tíma.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: How long is a dotted half note?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A half note is two beats; the dot adds one more.
rows.translation: Hálfnóta er tvö slög; punkturinn bætir við einu í viðbót.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A tie connects two notes. How many times do you tap?
rows.translation: Bindibogi tengir tvær nótur. Hve oft bankarðu?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: You tap the first note and hold through the second.
rows.translation: Þú bankar fyrstu nótuna og heldur út þá seinni.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Split the beat in three, then swing your eighths.
rows.translation: Skiptu slaginu í þrennt og sveiflaðu svo áttundapartsnótunum.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Triplets split the beat in three
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A triplet fits three even notes into one beat. Count 1-trip-let, 2-trip-let, with each syllable the same length.
rows.translation: Tríóla rúmar þrjár jafnar nótur í einu slagi. Teldu 1-og-a, 2-og-a, með jafnlangar atkvæðiseiningar.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: How many triplet notes fit in one beat?
rows.translation: Hve margar tríólunótur rúmast í einu slagi?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Triplets split each beat into three equal parts.
rows.translation: Tríólur skipta hverju slagi í þrjá jafna hluta.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Are the clicks in groups of two or three?
rows.translation: Eru smellirnir í tveggja eða þriggja hópum?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Eighths split the beat in two; triplets split it in three. The beat itself stays put. Only the way you divide it changes.
rows.translation: Áttundapartsnótur skipta slaginu í tvennt; tríólur skipta því í þrennt. Slagið sjálft helst óbreytt. Aðeins skipting þess breytist.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: You count 1-trip-let, 2-trip-let. What are you tapping?
rows.translation: Þú telur 1-og-a, 2-og-a. Hvað ertu að banka?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Three syllables per beat means three notes per beat: triplets.
rows.translation: Þrjár atkvæðiseiningar í slagi merkja þrjár nótur í slagi: tríólur.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In swing, each pair of eighths turns long-short. The "and" moves late, onto the last part of a triplet. Think doo-ba, doo-ba.
rows.translation: Í sveiflu verður hvert par áttundapartsnóta langt-stutt. „Og“ færist seinna, á síðasta hluta tríólu. Hugsaðu dú-ba, dú-ba.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Count 1-trip-let and tap only on "1" and "let." The gap in the middle is the swing.
rows.translation: Teldu 1-og-a og bankaðu aðeins á „1“ og „a“. Bilið í miðjunni er sveiflan.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In swing, where does the "and" land?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Swing delays the "and" to the last triplet, which gives the long-short lilt.
rows.translation: Sveifla seinkar „og“ að síðustu tríólunótunni, sem gefur langt-stutt sveifluna.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Jazz drummers play this on the ride cymbal: 1, 2, a swung "and," 3, 4, a swung "and." It sounds like ding, ding-a ding.
rows.translation: Djasstrommarar spila þetta á ride-diskinn: 1, 2, sveiflað „og“, 3, 4, sveiflað „og“. Það hljómar eins og ding, ding-a ding.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: How do you tap a swung "and"?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A swung "and" waits for the last triplet of the beat.
rows.translation: Sveiflað „og“ bíður eftir síðustu tríólunótu slagsins.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Straight eighths split the beat evenly; swung eighths go long-short. Tap one, then the other, and feel the difference.
rows.translation: Jafnar áttundapartsnótur skipta slaginu jafnt; sveiflaðar fara langt-stutt. Bankaðu fyrst aðra gerðina og svo hina og finndu muninn.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: This challenge mixes triplets, straight eighths and swing. Keep the beat steady while the way you split it changes.
rows.translation: Þessi áskorun blandar tríólum, jöfnum áttundapartsnótum og sveiflu. Haltu slaginu stöðugu á meðan skipting þess breytist.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Swing turns each pair of eighths into what?
rows.translation: Í hvað breytir sveifla hverju pari áttundapartsnóta?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The first eighth stretches and the "and" arrives late.
rows.translation: Fyrri áttundapartsnótan lengist og „og“ kemur seint.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Waltz in three, march in two, rock in 6/8, and place the accents.
rows.translation: Valsaðu í þremur, marséraðu í tveimur, ruggaðu í 6/8 og staðsettu áherslurnar.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In 3/4 time each bar has three beats: ONE, two, three. It's the waltz. Count 1, 2, 3 and lean on 1.
rows.translation: Í 3/4 takti hefur hver taktur þrjú slög: EINN, tveir, þrír. Þetta er valsinn. Teldu 1, 2, 3 og leggðu áherslu á 1.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A half note fills two of the three beats. Tap 1, count 2, tap 3. It feels like the big step and small step of a waltz.
rows.translation: Hálfnóta fyllir tvö af þremur slögunum. Bankaðu á 1, teldu 2, bankaðu á 3. Þetta er eins og stóra og litla skrefið í valsi.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: How many beats are in a bar of 3/4?
rows.translation: Hve mörg slög eru í takti í 3/4?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The top number of a time signature tells you how many beats are in each bar.
rows.translation: Efri tala taktvísis segir hve mörg slög eru í hverjum takti.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: 2/4 has two beats per bar: ONE, two, like marching feet. The bars go by quickly, so beat 1 comes around often.
rows.translation: 2/4 hefur tvö slög í takti: EINN, tveir, eins og marsandi fætur. Taktarnir líða fljótt hjá svo slag 1 kemur oft aftur.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Which meter feels like a march?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Two beats per bar match left, right, left, right.
rows.translation: Tvö slög í takti passa við vinstri, hægri, vinstri, hægri.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: In 6/8 each bar holds six eighth notes in two groups of three: ONE two three FOUR five six. It feels like two big, rocking beats.
rows.translation: Í 6/8 hefur hver taktur sex áttundapartsnótur í tveimur þriggja nótna hópum: EINN tveir þrír FJÓRIR fimm sex. Hann finnst eins og tvö stór, ruggandi slög.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The six eighths fall into two groups of three, so you feel two big beats.
rows.translation: Áttundapartsnóturnar sex skiptast í tvo þriggja nótna hópa svo þú finnur tvö stór slög.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: A favorite 6/8 pattern goes long-short, long-short: tap 1, 3, 4 and 6. It rocks like a lullaby or a sea shanty.
rows.translation: Vinsælt 6/8 mynstur fer langt-stutt, langt-stutt: bankaðu á 1, 3, 4 og 6. Það ruggar eins og vögguvísa eða sjómannasöngur.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Six clicks per bar. Which meter is this?
rows.translation: Sex smellir í takti. Hvaða taktgerð er þetta?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: An accent is a note played stronger than the ones around it. Move the accents and the feel changes, even when every note stays the same.
rows.translation: Áhersla er nóta sem er spiluð sterkar en þær í kring. Færðu áherslurnar og tilfinningin breytist, jafnvel þótt allar nóturnar haldist eins.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Count all eight eighths and tap just the accents: 1, the "and" of 2, and 4. This 3-3-2 pattern drives a lot of pop and Latin music.
rows.translation: Teldu allar átta áttundapartsnóturnar og bankaðu aðeins áherslurnar: 1, „og“ á eftir 2 og 4. Þetta 3-3-2 mynstur knýr mikla popp- og latíntónlist.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: An accent is about weight, not length. The note is simply played stronger.
rows.translation: Áhersla snýst um þunga, ekki lengd. Nótan er einfaldlega spiluð sterkar.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Rock, pop and soul put the accent on beats 2 and 4. This is the backbeat. Count all four and tap only 2 and 4, like a snare drum.
rows.translation: Rokk, popp og sálartónlist leggja áherslu á slög 2 og 4. Þetta er bakslagið. Teldu öll fjögur og bankaðu aðeins á 2 og 4, eins og sneriltromma.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: The first click is beat 1. Where are the strong clicks?
rows.translation: Fyrsti smellurinn er slag 1. Hvar eru sterku smellirnir?
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: This challenge moves between meters and accents. Before each tap step, count one bar under your breath to find beat 1.
rows.translation: Þessi áskorun færist milli taktgerða og áherslna. Fyrir hvert bankskref skaltu telja einn takt lágt til að finna slag 1.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Six eighth notes per bar, felt in two groups of three.
rows.translation: Sex áttundapartsnótur í takti, skynjaðar sem tveir þriggja nótna hópar.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Find your voice and sing in tune
rows.translation: Finndu röddina þína og syngdu hreint
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Stand tall, breathe low, hold your first steady note and sing a song.
rows.translation: Réttu úr þér, andaðu neðarlega, haltu fyrsta stöðuga tóninum og syngdu lag.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.translation: Réttu úr þér og slakaðu á
rows.author: is drafting AI 3

rows.source: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and knees soft. Let your shoulders drop and your head float up, as if a string lifts it. Keep your jaw loose.
rows.translation: Stattu með mjaðmabreidd á milli fóta og mjúk hné. Láttu axlirnar síga og höfuðið svífa upp, eins og band lyfti því. Hafðu kjálkann afslappaðan.
rows.author: is drafting AI 3
